source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each time an enemy unit finishes its attacks, you get one D6 for every melee attack it allocated to models in this unit, capped at six dice for that attacking unit; roll them, and each 4+ inflicts 1 **mortal wound** on the attacking unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.when: after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks
